name: Do(n't) Touch That Dial!
source:
You return to your childhood basement, where an old TV hides a dark secret. Your father disappeared one night, and now the TV is calling you. Will you resist, or will you be consumed?

[From [url=https://solsurge626.itch.io/dont-touch-that-dial]Itch.io[/url]]
